tool.name: Bifrost Bridge
tool.description: normalizes bioinformatics results and evaluates microbial quality-control rules
tool.command: #if not any([$mlst_output, $fastp_output, $quast_output, $plasmidfinder_output, $bracken_output, $amrfinder_output, $pmlst_output, $rmlst_output, $ssiamb_output, $shovill_output]): echo 'At least one QC result input must be supplied.' >&2 && exit 1 #else: bridge_qc #if $mlst_output: --mlst_path '$mlst_output' #end if #if $fastp_output: --fastp_path '$fastp_output' #end if #if $quast_output: --quast_path '$quast_output' #end if #if $plasmidfinder_output: --plasmidfinder_path '$plasmidfinder_output' #end if #if $bracken_output: --bracken_path '$bracken_output' #end if #if $amrfinder_output: --amrfinder_path '$amrfinder_output' #end if #if $pmlst_output: --pmlst_path '$pmlst_output' #end if #if $rmlst_output: --rmlst_path '$rmlst_output' #end if #if $ssiamb_output: --ssiamb_path '$ssiamb_output' #end if #if $shovill_output: --shovill_path '$shovill_output' #end if --output_path '$normalized_output' && uqcme --config '$uqcme_config' #end if

configfiles.configfile: title: "Bifrost Bridge microbial QC" version: "@UQCME_VERSION@" qc: input: data: file: '${normalized_output}' mapping: '${__tool_directory__}/config/mapping.yaml' qc_rules: '${__tool_directory__}/config/QC_rules.tsv' qc_tests: '${__tool_directory__}/config/QC_tests.tsv' output: results: '${qc_results}' warnings: '${qc_warnings}' log: file: '${log_file}'

param.name: quast_output
param.label: QUAST results
param.help: Transposed report.tsv output produced by QUAST.

param.name: bracken_output
param.label: Bracken/Kraken report
param.help: Kraken-style report containing unclassified and species-level rows.

param.name: rmlst_output
param.label: rMLST results
param.help: Normalized tabular output produced by the Galaxy rMLST tool.

param.name: ssiamb_output
param.label: SSI ambiguous-SNV results
param.help: Tabular ambiguous SNV count produced by SSIAMB.

param.name: shovill_output
param.label: Shovill log
param.help: Shovill log containing the average-coverage message.

tool.help:
Bifrost Bridge ==============
Bifrost Bridge converts outputs from supported microbial bioinformatics tools into a single, one-row tabular summary. It then runs uQCme to evaluate the normalized metrics against configurable quality-control rules.
At least one input must be supplied. Inputs are optional individually so that the wrapper can be used with whichever analyses are available for a sample.
Outputs -------
**Normalized metrics** The combined one-row table generated by ``bridge_qc``.
**QC results** The normalized table with uQCme outcomes and rule-evaluation columns.
**QC warnings** Warnings produced while loading or evaluating quality-control rules.
**uQCme log** Detailed processing messages from uQCme.
Multiple hits from tools such as AMRFinderPlus and PlasmidFinder are collapsed within a field using ``|`` as a separator.
The AMRFinderPlus database and tool versions are read directly from its result report and exposed together as ``AMR_dbv_toolv``.
The bundled QC rules are maintained by Statens Serum Institut. Results should be interpreted together with the laboratory's validated procedures and the versions of the contributing analysis tools.
